newsitem.title: UK: P&O dips despite better-than-expected profit.
newsitem.headline: P&O dips despite better-than-expected profit.

text.p: Shares in Pennisular & Oriental Steam Navigation Co Plc were down 1/2p to 594p by 0735 GMT despite better-than-expected half year result after the company warned of difficult trading conditions.
"P&O confirmed what the market already knew - that it faces a lot of competition, especially from Eurotunnel," one senior trader said.

P&O made an underlying pre-tax profit of 130.2 million stg compared with a consensus forecast of around 115.75 million but the company said rates remained under pressure following Eurotunnel Plc's decision "to slash" its tariffs.
The company said its bulk shipping market saw a downturn as a result of low rates for the capesize dry bulk market and warned that rates would remain under pressure into 1997.
